items.title: Sources: Rams reach record deal with McDuffie
items.description: The Los Angeles Rams and All-Pro cornerback Trent McDuffie reached agreement on a record four-year, $124 million extension that includes $100 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Sunday night.

items.title: Raiders trading for Bills CB Johnson, source says
items.description: The Raiders are sending a sixth-round pick to the Bills in exchange for veteran cornerback Taron Johnson and a seventh-round selection, a source told ESPN.

items.title: Source: Bengals won't tender backup QB Browning
items.description: The Cincinnati Bengals are not tendering restricted free agent quarterback Jake Browning, who started 10 games over three seasons in relief of Joe Burrow, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

items.title: Sources: Ingram back to Texans on 3-year deal
items.description: Texans guard Ed Ingram will not hit free agency after agreeing to return to Houston on a three-year, $37.5 million deal, according to ESPN and NFL Network.

items.title: Steelers to bring back CB Samuel, sources say
items.description: The Steelers are re-signing corner Asante Samuel Jr. to a one-year, $4 million deal, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

items.title: Sources: Conner reworks deal to stay with Cards
items.description: The Cardinals and Pro Bowl running back James Conner have agreed to a revised contract to keep him in Arizona for 2026, according to NFL Network.

items.title: Source: Wilson sticks with Vikings after big year
items.description: Linebacker Eric Wilson is staying with the Minnesota Vikings, as the sides agreed to a three-year, $22.5 million contract Sunday ahead of NFL free agency, according to NFL Network.
